# Python packages for build_og_cards.py (og-cards.yml): the image set plus
# CairoSVG for rasterizing SVG covers, with its whole dependency tree pinned
# and hashed, so `--only-binary :all:` resolves to wheels only and pip's
# hash-checking mode rejects anything that is not exactly these files. Runner
# is Python 3.12 on x86_64 Linux; the hashes are of the py3 / cp312 manylinux
# wheels (one per package). Dependabot bumps pins and hashes together.
-r requirements-images.txt
